linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04, Ubuntu 24.04
  • Processor: Quad Core Processor > 2.5Ghz, x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA 1060, AMD RX56, DirectX 11 or DirectX 12 and Shader Model 5.0
  • Additional Notes: Please set quality settings to low if you can't reach 60FPS, the game is way better when it's smooth.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 version 21H1 (build 19043) or newer
  • Processor: Quad Core Processor > 2.5Ghz, x86, x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA 1060, AMD RX56, DirectX 11 or DirectX 12 and Shader Model 5.0
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Please set quality settings to low if you can't reach 60FPS, the game is way better when it's smooth.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 version 21H1 (build 19043) or newer
  • Processor: Hexa Core processor > 3.0GHZ, x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA 2070 Super, AMD Radeon RX 7500 XT, DirectX 12 and Shader Model 5.0
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 6 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Please set quality settings to low if you can't reach 60FPS, the game is way better when it's smooth.
